root_cause: Mastercard credit transactions are being downgraded to higher-cost processing tiers due to missing Level 2/3 commercial card data.
diagnosis: The consistent fee overcharges across all three transactions indicate that the gateway is applying a higher interchange rate because it lacks the specific commercial card data (Level 2/3) required to qualify for lower commercial rates. Note: This analysis uses a modeled benchmark as the source status is illustrative.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2/3 commercial card data will allow the gateway to correctly classify these transactions and apply the lower interchange rates, eliminating the fee leakage.
